findings.requirement: All evidence timestamps must be unambiguous, timezone-aware, and causally bound across native execution, receipt creation, review, aggregation, and advancement.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/native_evidence.py validates timestamp only with datetime.fromisoformat and accepts naive timestamps; scripts/mros/bridge_receipt.py checks only created_at <= started_at <= finished_at. No cross-artifact comparison binds native_evidence.timestamp to receipt times or proves the evidence was produced before review/aggregation/advancement.
findings.falsifier: A strict test using a naive native timestamp, or a native timestamp after receipt.finished_at/review execution, is rejected; implement cross-artifact UTC ordering checks and rerun the frozen calibration cases.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Require timezone-aware UTC timestamps and explicit cross-artifact temporal ordering for native evidence, receipts, review outputs, aggregates, acceptance traces, and advancement.

findings.requirement: The reviewer/auditor population and membership denominator must be frozen before outcomes are available, with independently verifiable freeze evidence rather than a caller-supplied boolean.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/population_manifest.py accepts frozen_before_execution=True as a self-asserted field and validates no freeze timestamp, manifest hash, repository commit, mailbox receipt, or causal relation to execution. reconcile_population keys membership only by output_path and does not verify when the manifest was frozen. This permits future-derived membership or post-outcome population construction while passing the structural validator.
findings.falsifier: Provide a manifest created after one or more result files and show the validator rejects it; alternatively add signed/content-addressed freeze metadata and a test proving post-outcome manifests fail closed.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Bind manifests to immutable content hashes, freeze time, candidate commit, and bridge request evidence; reject manifests lacking independently verifiable pre-execution ordering and detect post-outcome membership.
